title: RNA extraction from formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue
author: Vlad Sandulache

steps.title: Prepare FFPE Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Prepare tissue sections from archival blocks of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas (OPSCC).

substeps.instruction: Trim excess paraffin off the sample block as much as possible.
Cut FFPE slide sections to 6 µm thickness on glass slides (or slice directly into Eppendorf tubes and store at Room temperature in a desiccator).
If more than 10 slides are needed, cut additional slides or proceed with a punch biopsy.

steps.title: Collect Tissue and Remove Paraffin
steps.instruction: Recover the tissue from the slides and remove the paraffin.

substeps.instruction: Use a fresh flat edge razor to scrape tissue sections from the slides into a sterile microcentrifuge tube.
Add 1 mL of xylene and vigorously vortex for 00:00:10 to remove penetrated paraffin.
Centrifuge at 14000 x g, Room temperature, 2 minutes and carefully remove the xylene without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Wash Tissue Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue pellet to remove residual xylene.

substeps.instruction: Wash the tissue pellet twice with 1 mL of 100% ethanol.
After each wash, centrifuge at 14000 x g, Room temperature, 2 minutes and discard supernatants.
Remove residual xylene after the second wash and air-dry the pellet for 00:05:00 - 00:10:00.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Lysis the tissue and digest proteins using Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by adding 150 µL of buffer PKD and flicking the tube to loosen the pellet.
Incubate on ice for 00:03:00.
Incubate at 56 °C for 00:15:00 on a heating block.
Add 10 µL of proteinase K and mix by vortexing.
Incubate at 80 °C for 00:15:00 on a heating block.

steps.title: Separate RNA and DNA
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA-containing supernatant from the DNA-containing pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14000 x g, 4 °C, 15 minutes.
Carefully transfer the supernatant (containing RNA) to a new 2.0 mL safe-lock microcentrifuge tube.
Store the remaining pellet at -20 °C for subsequent DNA purification.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Binding Solution
steps.instruction: Adjust the supernatant for RNA binding to the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 1120 µL 100% ethanol to the supernatant and mix well by vortexing for 00:00:05.
Add 320 µL of Buffer RLT to adjust binding conditions and mix by vortexing.
Flash spin at Room temperature to remove drops from inside the lid.

steps.title: RNA Binding and Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the RNeasy MinElute spin column and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the sample to an RNeasy MinElute spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube; close lid gently.
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation steps until the entire sample has passed through the column.
Add 500 µL Buffer FRN to the column (ensure Buffer FRN is reconstituted by adding 42 mL isopropanol (96–100%) to 14 mL concentrate and equilibrated to 15 °C – 25 °C).
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNase I stock by dissolving 1500 Kunitz units of lyophilized DNase I in 550 µL RNase-free water (inject water into vial with needle/syringe, do not open or vortex).
Prepare DNase I solution by adding 10 µL of stock to 70 µL of Buffer RDD (mix by gentle inversion, do not vortex).
Add 80 µL DNase I solution directly to the RNeasy MinElute spin column membrane.
Place on the benchtop (20 °C – 30 °C) for 00:15:00.
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA using Buffer FRN and Buffer RPE.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 µL Buffer FRN to the column (reconstituted as described previously).
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds; save the flow-through for use in the next step (contains small RNAs).
Place the column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, 2 minutes; discard flow-through.
Place the column back in the same collection tube and centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the column (reconstituted by adding 44 mL 100% ethanol to 11 mL Buffer RPE concentrate and shaking).
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Add another 500 µL Buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, 15 seconds; discard flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Elution and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA and assess its quality.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL – 30 µL RNase-free water directly to the RNeasy MinElute spin column membrane.
Incubate for 00:02:00 at Room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, 1 minute to elute the RNA.
Keep RNA on ice for immediate use or store at -80 °C.
Measure concentration and quality using Nanodrop (Cytation 3 imaging reader and Gen5 Image 2.07 software), targeting 260/280 ratio of 1.8-2.0 and 260/230 ratio of 2.0-2.2.
